kpis.description_en: Personal Care segment (cosmetics, skincare). Largest group segment.

kpis.description_en: Life Sciences (pharma adjuvants, mRNA lipids). High-margin segment post-COVID normalization.

kpis.description_fr: R&D portfolio diversifié bio-ingrédients. 1500+ brevets actifs portfolio Croda.
kpis.description_en: Diversified bio-ingredients R&D portfolio. 1500+ active Croda patents.

kpis.description_en: ~65% bio-origin raw materials (vegetable oils). ESG differentiation vs petrochemicals.

kpis_story.description_fr: Croda fournit lipides ionizable Pfizer mRNA vaccines (Acuitas Therapeutics partnership). Pic 2021-2022 puis normalisation, futur GLP-1 et oncologie en pipeline.
kpis_story.description_en: Croda supplies ionizable lipids Pfizer mRNA vaccines (Acuitas Therapeutics partnership). 2021-2022 peak then normalization, GLP-1 and oncology pipeline ahead.

kpis_story.description_fr: Stratégie M&A bolt-on biotech (Avanti Polar Lipids 2020 $185M, Iberchem 2020 €820M, Solus Bio 2021). Pivot vers ingrédients pharma.
kpis_story.description_en: Biotech bolt-on M&A strategy (Avanti Polar Lipids 2020 $185M, Iberchem 2020 €820M, Solus Bio 2021). Pivot to pharma ingredients.

_notes: CRDA = UK specialty chemicals leader (FTSE 100). Modèle: bio-sourced ingredients pour cosmétiques + pharma + agriculture.
